first.rationale: Targeted pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior acquisition and revenue evidence. However, its effect on long-term qualified revenue is not established, so the test should be guarded and the original pricing record verified for retention, customer quality, margins, and durability. Verify onboarding evidence as the strongest alternative given the concurrent completion and activation declines.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified record shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable value. Reject promotional pricing because its verified cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Long-term qualified revenue was not directly measured for onboarding, so the experiment should track retained qualified revenue and cohort quality downstream.
